page.content:
Unseen lord of the dead and of the earth's wealth.

How Hades connects

  • Location: Underworld — Hades is lord of the Underworld.
  • Character: Persephone — Persephone reigns beside Hades as queen of the dead.
  • Character: Zeus — Zeus and Hades divided sky and Underworld after the Titans fell.

What is Hades?

Hades drew the Underworld when the cosmos was divided. He rules the dead with Persephone, rarely leaves his halls, and is not death itself but the king of that country.

Key threads lead to Underworld, Persephone and Zeus.
